g.text: Read the workspace instructions: use pnpm, run make verify.
The redirect drops the return path when the session
expires. I'll keep it in the login URL and restore it
after sign-in, in both api and web.
What agents started through the launcher get, and which agents the + menu lists.
Agents started through the launcher get ~/.herdr/AGENTS.md, how to use
automations, helpers and the board, before the workspace's own
Bring agents back after a restart
Claude and Antigravity agents started through the launcher continue their
conversation after a reboot or a logout.
The tab bar's + lists the agents installed here. Turn off the ones you don't use; a right-click
on an agent in the + menu hides it too.
Hidden agents are only left out of the + menu. Presets and automations can still start them.
